fr_html: Mr. ROOT rappelle que, lors de la première séance du Comité, il a proposé de prendre pour base des discussions cette Convention. Cependant le Comité est maintenant d'accord pour prendre comme base le projet des Cinq Puissances.
en_html: Mr. ROOT recalled that at the first meeting of the Committee he had proposed to take that Convention as a basis for discussion. However, the Committee was now agreed to take the project of the Five Powers as base.
fr_text: Mr. ROOT rappelle que, lors de la première séance du Comité, il a proposé de prendre pour base des discussions cette Convention. Cependant le Comité est maintenant d'accord pour prendre comme base le projet des Cinq Puissances.
en_text: Mr. ROOT recalled that at the first meeting of the Committee he had proposed to take that Convention as a basis for discussion. However, the Committee was now agreed to take the project of the Five Powers as base.
